units.source_text: 柏木到时，王侯公卿们尚未到齐。

en.t: When Kashiwagi arrived, the princes and high nobles had not yet all gathered.

units.source_text: 源氏照例叫他走进近旁的帘内来，把正屋的帘子放下，和他会面。

en.t: As usual, Genji had him come inside the nearby curtains, lowered the blinds of the main room, and received him there.

units.source_text: 但见柏木非常消瘦，脸色发青。

en.t: He saw that Kashiwagi had grown very thin, and that his face was pale and bluish.

units.source_text: 他本来不及诸弟那么愉快活泼，而温厚周谨，则胜于常人。

en.t: He had never been as cheerful and lively as his younger brothers, but in gentleness, kindness, and careful reserve he surpassed ordinary people.

units.source_text: 但今日态度特别斯文一脉。

en.t: Today, however, his manner was especially refined and subdued.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得此人作为公主之婿，实无瑕疵可指。

en.t: Genji felt that, as a husband for the princess, this man truly had no flaw to criticize.

units.source_text: 只是此次之事，男女两方都太糊涂，其罪不可原宥。

en.t: Only in this recent affair had both the man and the woman been far too foolish, and their fault could not be forgiven.

units.source_text: 他向柏木注视，心中觉得可恶，但脸上绝不表示，还是亲切地对他说道：

en.t: He gazed at Kashiwagi and felt disgust in his heart, but showed none of it on his face and still spoke to him kindly:

units.source_text: “只因无甚要事，所以久不见面了。

en.t: “Since there has been no particular business, we have not seen each other for a long time.

units.source_text: 近几月来，我为了照顾两处病人，心烦意乱，片刻不暇。

en.t: For these past several months I have been caring for sick people in two places, and I have been troubled and distracted, without a moment to spare.

units.source_text: 在这期间，这里的三公主欲举办法事，为朱雀院祝寿，但亦未能顺利进行。

en.t: During that time, the Third Princess here wished to hold a Buddhist service and celebrate Retired Emperor Suzaku's birthday, but even that could not proceed smoothly.

units.source_text: 现在年关已经迫近，诸事都不能办得如意称心，只得奉献一些素菜，聊以应名而已。

en.t: Now the year end is already close, and nothing can be arranged as we would like, so we can only offer a few vegetarian dishes and barely preserve the name of the occasion.

units.source_text: 称为祝寿，似乎排场十分盛大，其实不过是教上皇看看我家所生许多子孙而已。

en.t: Calling it a birthday celebration makes it sound very grand, but in truth it is only to let the retired emperor see the many children and grandchildren born in our family.

units.source_text: 因此我就发心叫他们学习舞蹈。

en.t: For that reason I decided to have them learn dancing.

units.source_text: 寿宴上舞乐总是少不得的。

en.t: At a birthday banquet, music and dance are always indispensable.

units.source_text: 惟指导拍子的人，想来想去，除了你之外没有别人可请。

en.t: But as for someone to guide the rhythm, after thinking it over and over, there is no one I can ask except you.

units.source_text: 所以我不怪你长久不来，定要邀你到场。”

en.t: So I do not blame you for being away so long, but I must ask you to attend.”

units.source_text: 他说时和颜悦色，毫无别意。

en.t: As he spoke, his expression was gentle and pleasant, showing no other intention at all.

units.source_text: 柏木反而难为情起来，面孔都变色了，一时说不出答语，好容易开口道：

en.t: Kashiwagi became all the more embarrassed, his face changed color, and for a while he could not answer; at last he managed to speak:

units.source_text: “我也闻知大人为各处病人之事烦忙。

en.t: “I too have heard that my lord has been busy with the sick people in various places.

units.source_text: 我自今春以来，患了讨厌的脚气病，最近发作得很厉害，踏也踏不下去。

en.t: Since this spring I have suffered from a troublesome case of beriberi, and lately the attacks have become so severe that I cannot even set my foot down.

units.source_text: 日子久了，身体愈见衰弱。

en.t: As the days have gone on, my body has grown steadily weaker.

units.source_text: 因此连宫中也没有去，一直笼闭在家中，仿佛与世隔绝了。

en.t: Because of this, I have not even gone to the palace, but have remained shut up at home as if cut off from the world.

units.source_text: 家父对我说：‘今年朱雀院龄满五十，我家应该特别隆重地为他祝寿。’

en.t: My father said to me, ‘This year Retired Emperor Suzaku turns fifty, and our family ought to celebrate his birthday with special ceremony.’

units.source_text: 但他又说：‘我已不惜挂冠悬车，身无官职，参与贺寿礼式，无有适当座位。

en.t: But he also said, ‘I have already given up office and hold no official post, so if I take part in the birthday rites, there will be no proper seat for me.

units.source_text: 你官位虽然还低，但与父亲同样怀抱大志。

en.t: Although your rank is still low, you hold great ambitions just as your father does.

units.source_text: 让上皇看看你的抱负吧。’

en.t: Let the retired emperor see your aspirations.’

units.source_text: 家父如此催促，我只得熬着重病，前往拜寿。

en.t: Since my father urged me in this way, I had no choice but to endure my grave illness and come to offer birthday greetings.

units.source_text: 家父知道：朱雀院专精佛道，近来生活益见清静，料想他不喜欢领受过于隆重的贺仪，所以万事崇尚简略。

en.t: My father knew that Retired Emperor Suzaku was devoted to the Buddhist path and had lately lived more and more quietly, and he supposed that the emperor would not like to receive excessively grand congratulations, so he kept everything simple.

units.source_text: 朱雀院所深愿的，是大家静静地谈谈，我们应该顺从他的愿望。”

en.t: What Retired Emperor Suzaku deeply wishes is for everyone to talk quietly together, and we should follow his wish.”

units.source_text: 源氏早就听说落叶公主为父皇举办盛大寿宴，现在听见柏木说成父亲主办，觉得他用心很周到。

en.t: Genji had long heard that Princess Ochiba was holding a grand birthday banquet for her father, but now that he heard Kashiwagi present it as arranged by his own father, he thought his consideration was very thorough.

units.source_text: 便答道：“一点也不错！

en.t: He answered, “That is exactly right!

units.source_text: 世人都以为简略就是疏慢，只有你知情达理，所以能说这话。

en.t: People generally think simplicity means negligence, but you alone understand the circumstances and the proper reasoning, and so you can say this.

units.source_text: 如此说来，我的见解很对，以后我更放心了。

en.t: Hearing it put that way, I see that my view was quite right, and from now on I can feel even more at ease.

units.source_text: 我家夕雾在朝廷，也逐渐像大人模样，但对此种情趣，向来不感兴味。

en.t: My Yugiri has gradually begun to seem grown up at court, but he has never shown much interest in this kind of refinement.

units.source_text: 关于上皇，无论何事，你总没有不详悉的吧。

en.t: As for the retired emperor, there is surely nothing about him that you do not know in detail.

units.source_text: 就中对于音乐，我知道他特别爱好，而且非常精通。

en.t: In particular, I know that he especially loves music and is extremely well versed in it.

units.source_text: 出家为僧、舍弃世事之后，可以静心听赏，现在一定更加爱好音乐了。

en.t: After becoming a monk and leaving worldly affairs behind, he can listen and appreciate it in peace, so he must love music even more now.

units.source_text: 我想请你和夕雾共同努力，好好地教养那班学舞的童子。

en.t: I would like you and Yugiri to work together and properly train those boys who are learning the dances.

units.source_text: 那些专门技师，只是精通自己的业务，却不懂得教养，不足道也。”

en.t: Those professional instructors know their own craft well enough, but they do not understand how to cultivate people, and are hardly worth speaking of.”

units.source_text: 说时态度非常亲切。

en.t: As he said this, his manner was extremely kind.

units.source_text: 柏木一则以喜，一则以惧，心中惶惑不安，很少说话。

en.t: Kashiwagi was both pleased and afraid; confused and uneasy at heart, he said very little.

units.source_text: 他只巴望早点儿离去，因此并不详细回答。

en.t: He only wished to leave as soon as possible, and therefore did not answer in detail.

units.source_text: 后来好容易脱身而出。

en.t: Later, he finally managed to extricate himself and leave.

units.source_text: 夕雾在东院花散里夫人那边训练乐人和舞人，得了柏木的帮助，装束等又添了些新花样。

en.t: Yugiri was training the musicians and dancers at Lady Hanachirusato's quarters in the eastern mansion, and with Kashiwagi's help, new ideas were added to the costumes and other details.

units.source_text: 夕雾已经尽心竭力，而柏木用意更加周详，可见此人对于此道修养甚深。

en.t: Yugiri had already put forth all his effort, but Kashiwagi's planning was even more meticulous, showing how deeply cultivated he was in this art.
